author: IcyCode
body:
Hello there minecrafters,
I am here today to present the official FennerCraft Build Team. We have been a small team for a little while and are looking for new recruits to join us! As long as we think you have potential you are in! Our build team already has several members so please check my website: http://fennercraft.github.io/ to see who the latest members are. We have a dedicated server for this and you will need to be contacted for the ip of the server to build with us!

Accepted Applicants:
  • carrie_may
  • brickbuster_tim
  • cole1crc
  • cedd2701

Good luck to everybody!

Application Format:

  • What timezone are you located in:
  • How can the build team benefit from you being part of it (Explain what your strengths are:
  • What previous experience do you have building maps for Avicus and other servers: (Please provide pictures etc.)
  • Why should you be trusted as a member of our build team:
Good luck to everyone and I will talk to accepted applicants in game at some point
